description:
Arc 4 (Arc 47) cut of operating-disciplines.md (2156 lines — the worst offender; grew from 2110 at epic start via §33 [Arc 1] + §34 [Arc 3 Stage 1]). Dispatched by polybius-the-stoa 2026-05-23T08:58:28Z.

DIRECTIVE:
- Apply the PROVEN 3-bucket method (Arc 2) + the subproject-recompose mechanism (op-disc deploys to ALL tiers, so recompose applies same as POLYBIUS).
- RECALIBRATED CRITERION (PRINCIPAL-ratified): lossless-floor is an OUTPUT measured per file; falsify on LOSSLESS-COMPLETENESS (every chunk homed + recoverable), NOT a line-number. Do NOT set a fixed line target meetable only by moving always-on rules off-disk. REPORT THE EMPIRICAL FLOOR.
- EXTRA CARE: op-disc is UNIVERSAL — every seat (POLYBIUS/PLINY/all CAPTAINs) loads it. ARGUS LOST-CANON audit is primary; the cut must hold lossless for the WHOLE TEAM, not one seat. The KEEP bucket = the universal always-on operational core every seat needs.
- C-2-style provenance with no clean bw home -> dedicated child tickets (Arc-2 precedent).
- Use the Arc-1 composition mechanism (modules + routing-map + relocation-index) + the §34 trigger-payload authoring rule (now canon).
- Section-number PRESERVE via stubs (Arc-2 precedent, zero cross-ref churn) — esp. important here since op-disc is cross-referenced by EVERY role file + module.

GAUNTLET: DAEDALUS cut design -> ARGUS (LOST-CANON primary, whole-team) -> ADA -> VERA + CATO + ZENO. Backlog palate-cleansers (2i5/vr1/tvc) may slot opportunistically but op-disc is priority.

comments.text: DAEDALUS activated on stoa--xyb.8 (op-disc cut, Arc 47). Reading brief + research input (Arc-1/Arc-2 proven mechanism + modules/README.md) + op-disc 2156 lines. Worktree branch arc-47/build confirmed.

Mechanism absorbed: Arc-1 modules/README.md (3 classes) + Arc-2 design-rev2 (stubs/markers/recompose) + install.sh recompose_module_inline() ALREADY data-driven (L870-962, called on DEST_POLYBIUS only). op-disc deployed via plain cp at L974-980 at ALL tiers. Now mapping op-disc sections + cross-ref graph (which op-disc §N are cited elsewhere -> must stub-preserve).

Full op-disc map complete (thesis + §1-§34 + tail). Cross-ref graph: nearly EVERY top-level §N is cited from active substrate files (role files/install.sh/hooks/templates/skills/modules) -> validates section-number-preserve-via-stubs strongly. KEY DESIGN DISTINCTION surfaced: op-disc is NOT an orchestrator (no dispatch role), so it has no routing-map/relocation-index of its own. The CONDITIONAL modules op-disc relocates are read by the SEAT THAT NEEDS THEM (e.g. a seat entering autonomous mode reads autonomous-mode-setup.md), not dispatched by op-disc. Resolving where the relocation-index lives + the module-namespace question (POLYBIUS modules + op-disc modules share substrate/modules/) before drafting.

LOAD-BEARING install.sh finding: recompose_module_inline() Check B uses GLOBAL substrate/modules/*.md glob. Adding op-disc modules to the shared dir makes POLYBIUS recompose Check B FALSE-POSITIVE (op-disc modules unconsumed by POLYBIUS markers -> abort subproject deploy). FIX = scope recompose to a per-call OWNED-module-set (module-ownership partition). Also resolved: op-disc gets a RELOCATION INDEX (audit-time, losslessness recovery) but NOT a routing-map (op-disc is not an orchestrator; no dispatch role). Drafting design-rev1.md now.

pass: op-disc cut design-rev1 complete + committed (arc-47/build 00e2707). Path: agents/design/arc-47/design-rev1.md (573 lines). LEDGER: 13 CONDITIONAL -> 13 new modules; 18 C-1 + 3 C-2 + 5 SPLIT provenance; 0 DUPLICATE (op-disc §12 is the keep-home). Empirical floor ESTIMATE ~700-850 (reported not targeted). CROSS-REF CHECK: nearly every top-level §N cited from active files; all RELOCATE sections stub-preserved (§7 stub names §7.1-§7.7; §15/§22/§27 stubs name cited subsections); runtime-script citers (hooks/save-verdict) cite §N in COMMENTS not runtime paths -> no break. LOAD-BEARING install.sh extension: module-OWNERSHIP partition (recompose_module_inline gains per-call owned-set arg) - REQUIRED because op-disc modules share substrate/modules/ with Arc-2 POLYBIUS modules + current global-glob Check B would false-positive; op-disc recompose extended to DEST_OPERATING_DISCIPLINES at subproject tier. Top weak points: (1) ownership-partition signature change is highest-risk (regression breaks BOTH role files at subproject); (2) §7 most-cited relocation incl runtime hooks; (3) routing-map OMITTED (op-disc not an orchestrator - relocation index only) = the one pattern-refinement, surfaced as residual Q1 for ARGUS. Returning to PLINY; dispatch ARGUS (LOST-CANON whole-team primary).

ARGUS activated on stoa--xyb.8 (op-disc cut, Arc 47). AUTONOMOUS. Reading design-rev1 end-to-end + independently walking op-disc 2156 lines for LOST-CANON (whole-team primary) + cross-ref preservation across whole substrate. Heartbeats to follow.

Design pass 1 complete (574 lines read). Now independently walking live op-disc 2156 lines section-by-section + grepping whole substrate for cross-refs. Verifying ledger covers every chunk; spot-checking C-1 cites + stoa--ntn (WP4).

FINDING (cross-ref, [BLOCKING]): design §3.1 cross-ref check scoped grep to substrate/ ONLY and never grepped SPECIFICATION.md (repo root). validate-spec spec_refs.py resolves op-disc cross-refs by EXACT heading-line match. Empirically ran it: bare §7.1/§7.2/§7.4/§7.5 in SPECIFICATION.md currently PASS against op-disc subsection HEADINGS (lines 121/142/180/200) which the §7 relocation moves INTO the module -> 7 refs flip PASS->FAIL in the Pass-9 mechanical check. P-XREF does not catch (excludes SPECIFICATION.md + only greps stub PROSE not headings). Now checking C-1 cites + stoa--ntn (WP4) + ambient-vs-conditional calls.

C-1 provenance CLEARED: spot-checked 17/18 standalone C-1 ids + stoa--ntn (WP4) — ALL resolve + carry their N=1 story materially. stoa--ntn carries the §10 progression table -> WP4 is a NON-finding (C-2 fallback not needed; per-deletion gate still correct). install.sh recompose VERIFIED: Check-B global-glob false-positive is REAL + correctly diagnosed. NEW FINDING [SHOULD-FIX]: design §6.4 says 'Check A stays global, only Check-B/D change' but Check A (L916 'name in exists') shares the SAME exists[] array as Check B — narrowing module_list to owned-set silently narrows Check A too. Design is internally inconsistent re the highest-risk function. Now checking Q2 (literal MODULE-INLINE in source bodies) + §20 partial (Q4) + ambient-vs-conditional A1-A4.

Q2 CLEARED (op-disc source has ZERO literal MODULE-INLINE strings -> no relocated body can carry one; Check E covers ADA-introduced ones at deploy). Q4 (§20 partial): losslessness sound, all cross-refs preserved (only §20+§20.3 externally cited, both KEEP inline); ONE numbering-order wrinkle (relocated §20.1 re-inlines AFTER §20.4 at subproject tier) = CONSIDER not lost-canon. Now adjudicating ambient-vs-conditional A1-A4 + verifying §16/§17/§30 (KEEP in POLYBIUS per brief) genuinely conditional in op-disc.

MAJOR FINDING [SHOULD-FIX], A3/A4 adjudication: the design's A4 rationale for RELOCATING §15 is FACTUALLY WRONG. A4 claims 'verifier CAPTAINs are dispatched-with-brief; PLINY names verification-complexity.md in the brief.' But VERA §5.7, CATO §6.7, ZENO §6.6, ARGUS §6.6 ALL point at 'operating-disciplines.md §15' DIRECTLY from their own role files, on every dispatch — IDENTICAL mechanics to §25.5 (which the design KEEPs as A3 'read-direct'). PLINY does NOT name the module in verifier briefs. So by the design's OWN A3 principle, §15 is a KEEP candidate, not RELOCATE. §15 + §25.5 have identical consumer patterns yet land on opposite sides of a boundary that does not distinguish them. Confirmed §16/§17/§30 genuinely conditional (RELOCATE sound). Drafting verdict; checking §11 + finalizing.
